modules.description: Draft Lumina JavaScript port of the AniKoto Anime CloudStream provider. Search, details, sub/dub episode discovery, and best-effort stream resolution; playback remains unverified.
Lumina-native provider adapter for Bollyflix: search, catalogue, title details, and source discovery. Direct playback depends on the site's current link format.
Lumina-native Stremio/Cinemeta metadata adapter. Uses Lumina Player's handler contract; provider-specific playback extraction is not included.
Lumina-native provider adapter for MoviesDrive: search, catalogue, title details, and source discovery. Direct playback depends on the site's current link format.
Lumina-native JavaScript port of the Moviesmod provider from CSX. Supports search, title details, source/episode discovery, and direct playable links when the host exposes them.
Lumina-native provider adapter for VegaMovies: search, catalogue, title details, and source discovery. Direct playback depends on the site's current link format.
Diagnostic provider for testing Lumina Player's search, episode resolution, and native MP4 playback handler contract.
